clips.title: The story
paras: Inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Thorgas Grimson trains new hunters. A seasoned outdoorsman of Dun Morogh, he believes the frozen wilds teach survival best.

Thorgas Grimson welcomes new mountaineers and scouts inside Anvilmar. He teaches young hunters to leave dry lectures behind and learn in the freezing winds. With bow or gun in hand, they track Dun Morogh's rugged beasts firsthand.
